purpose: Per-fact evidence for pack.json (CMP-031), moved unchanged from the former SOURCES.md. Status: tested (structure only, schema and unit tests pass). Every fact in pack.json is UNVERIFIED (evidenceStatus: unverified). Source: the CMP-030 research, docs/compliance/qatar-research.md. Access date for every URL read: 2026-11-18; the KPMG and vatupdate pages were search excerpts only, so they carry read: false and no access date. Labels: VERIFIED-OFFICIAL, SECONDARY (treat as UNVERIFIED), UNVERIFIED, PLATFORM-DEFAULT (a platform choice, not a statutory claim). Each claim keeps the former value and evidence text. The pack holds declarative metadata only: no tax maths, no rates (ADR-0031). Nothing here is legal or tax advice.
